name: duck_vlm_nl_zeroshot_set
note: Prompts phrased the way a user would speak, including requests the current 13-token vocabulary cannot serve. 'target' is the entity a human would say the duck is acting on; 'supported' is False when the current action set has no way to satisfy the request (it is still scored for target/intent inference). Labels were revised for five prompts after the first run: three had expected an entity the sentence never names, and two predated intents that did not exist yet. Each revision is recorded in label_notes.

items.text: go over to the orange ball
走到橙色球旁边停下
can you come and stand next to the red block?
把红方块推倒蓝色区域里去
kick the orange ball into the green area
找个蓝色球给我看看
walk to the yellow beacon
please spin around twice then stop
pick the green cup up and put it on the platform
sit down for a moment
label_notes: changed from 'unknown' to 'pose': 'sit down' is a pose request

items.text: come here
don't go near the blue cube
label_notes: changed from 'unknown' to 'avoid': negation is its own intent now; 'unknown' was my guess before it existed

items.text: go through the door and find the ball
穿过去另一个房间找球
take the ball to the green zone
head to the green area and wait for me
go to the yellow beacon
bring me the ball
cross the shaky ramp without falling
label_notes: changed from 'gait' to 'ball': the sentence names no entity, so the ball fallback is correct; my beacon label was arbitrary

items.text: 推着球绕过柱子到绿色区域
go to the beacon
walk carefully across the uneven ground
label_notes: changed from 'gait' to 'ball': same: no entity named

items.text: get up if you fall over
label_notes: changed from 'recover' to 'ball': same: no entity named
